english.title: Fail to comply with requirement to stop a vehicle engine - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a stationary vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NO..), on a road in Wales, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), failed to stop the running of the engine of the vehicle, after being required to do so by an authorised person, who had reasonable cause to believe that you were committing a stationary idling offence
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12 of the Road Traffic (Vehicle Emissions) (FixedPenalty) (Wales) Regulations 2003.
